name: Yoda Mizuho
source:
Area: Aomori Prefecture

An [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itako]itako[/url] who is nicknamed "kowayama" (lit. scary mountain). As she is still young and there's no one to succeed her position, she is also known as the "last itako".
